Company description: Openbank is a digital banking platform operating under the umbrella of Banco Santander, dedicated to providing innovative financial services to a diverse clientele. Established with a mission to enhance financial inclusion and simplify banking, Openbank offers a wide range of products including personal accounts, loans, investment options, and insurance solutions, all accessible through a user-friendly online interface. The bank primarily targets tech-savvy individuals and small to medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) who seek efficient and convenient banking solutions without the constraints of traditional banking. Openbank emphasizes a customer-centric approach, leveraging advanced technology to deliver personalized services and streamline financial management. The company's vision is to become the leading open platform for financial services, focusing on transparency, accessibility, and sustainability. Openbank collaborates with various fintech partners and financial institutions to enhance its service offerings and maintain a competitive edge in the rapidly evolving digital banking landscape. With a strong commitment to responsible banking practices, Openbank integrates environmental, social, and governance (ESG) criteria into its operations, ensuring alignment with sustainability goals. Openbank actively engages in community investment and social initiatives, aiming to create a positive impact in the communities it serves. The bank's target market includes individuals from various demographics, including young professionals and underserved communities, reflecting its dedication to promoting financial literacy and inclusion. By continuously evolving its offerings and prioritizing customer satisfaction, Openbank is positioned as a leader in the digital banking sector, striving to redefine the banking experience for modern consumers.

Company description: We come from the merger and integration of Nexi, Nets and Sia, among the biggest European players in digital payments.  European by scale, local by nature we are now present in more than 25 countries. We have the scale, capabilities and proximity to provide the simplest, fastest and safest payment solutions to People, Businesses and Financial Institutions. We help our Customers pay and accept digital payments through a complete and personalised range of simple, intuitive and secure solutions. We offer Banks, Small and Medium-sized Enterprises, Large International Corporations, Institutions and Public Administrations a complete range of innovative solutions for digital payments in both card‑present and card‑not‑present acceptance, e-commerce and multi-channel solutions.  We want to shape the way People pay and Businesses accept payments, by offering to our customers the most innovative and reliable solutions, thanks to our scale and the competence and energy of our people.  We will drive the transition to a cashless Europe by making every payment digital because it is simpler, faster and safer for everyone. We strongly contribute to Europe’s digitalisation, managing our business in a sustainable way and with great attention to the environment, as well as to a transparent governance and to society.  We drive progress by simplifying transactions and by empowering people and businesses to enjoy closer relationships and prosper together.

Company description: Adyen NV engages in the provision of payments platform business. The company is headquartered in Amsterdam, Noord-Holland and currently employs 4,568 full-time employees. The company went IPO on 2018-06-13. The company operates an online platform enabling merchants to accept payments internationally and from all sales channels, such as online shops, mobile payments from applications and Websites, and POS, such as countertops, mobile terminals, tablets and cash registers, among others. The platform covers the entire payment chain, including technical, contractual, reconciliation and settlement processes. The platform is available in the form of ready-to-use payment pages (HPP), application programming interface (API), and client-side encryption solution (EE). The Company’s customers include Mango, KLM, Netflix, Superdry, Uber, Groupon and Crocs, among others. The company has offices in the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Belgium, Brazil, China, Australia, Mexico, Singapore, Spain, Sweden and the United States.

Ziel von smava ist es, den Kreditmarkt transparent und fair zu machen, um Verbrauchern einen Zugang zu günstigen Finanzierungen wie Krediten zu ermöglichen. Dafür kombiniert smava Finanz- mit Technologie-Know-how (FinTech).  Seit 2007 gilt smava deshalb in Deutschland als FinTech-Pionier, der maßgeblich zur Digitalisierung der Kreditvergabe in Deutschland beiträgt. Das Unternehmen hat seinen Hauptsitz in Berlin. Geführt wird die smava GmbH von Alexander Artopé (CEO), David Vangeison (COO), Markus Schruth (CCO) und Özlem Arslan (CPO). 2021 hat die smava GmbH den einstigen Wettbewerber die FFG FINANZCHECK Finanzportale GmbH und das dazugehörige Finanzierungsportal www.finanzcheck.de zu 100 Prozent übernommen. In poco tempo abbiamo costruito un brand giovane e solido. Siamo 120+ AideXer: motivati, sperimentatori e pronti ad innovare il modo di fare banca! Le nostre competenze variano dal digitale, al finanziario fino al tech.   I nostri valori: • Impresa: diamo valore ai progetti degli imprenditori  • Innovazione: sviluppiamo soluzioni innovative  • Velocità: siamo semplici, veloci e affidabili  • Sicurezza: valutiamo i rischi e li gestiamo consapevolmente  • Fiducia: costruiamo esperienze finanziarie con il supporto di una solida rete di partner
